---
title: "Choosing columns"
---

{{< include ../_setup.qmd >}}

`pick` names the columns you want.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### R

```{r}
sales |> pick(product, revenue)
```

### Python

```{python}
sales >> pick(col.product, col.revenue)
```

:::

Wrap the names in `all_but` to say which ones to drop instead. It is the same
verb, because choosing columns is choosing columns whichever way you say which
ones, and it is the same word in both languages.

::: {.panel-tabset}

### R

```{r}
sales |> pick(all_but(cost, region))
```

### Python

```{python}
sales >> pick(all_but(col.cost, col.region))
```

:::
